answer_4.quote: When possible, one can also improve validation by evaluating matched items (posts, sentences, documents etc.) to humans for evaluation. Humans can either (a) use a scale (e.g., a 1-5 Likert scale) to rate items individually on their propensity for treatment, or (b) assess similarity of paired items after matching.
